description: Find Wayback Machine snapshots of a URL. Mode "closest" returns the single nearest capture to a given timestamp via the Availability API, falling back to a CDX closest-capture query when the Availability API has no answer (one result). Mode "history" returns the full capture list via the CDX API — filterable by date range and HTTP status code, collapsed by default to one capture per day (collapse "timestamp:8"); collapse "timestamp:14" lists one row per distinct capture second. Use history mode to survey how a page changed over time; use closest mode when you need the snapshot nearest a specific date. History mode returns up to limit records (at most 10,000 per call) and supports resume-key pagination for URLs with very large capture histories.

collapse.description: CDX collapse parameter (history mode only). Format: "timestamp:N" where N is 1–14 (4=year, 6=month, 8=day, 10=hour, 14=second): consecutive captures sharing the first N timestamp digits are listed once. Omitted or blank, it is "timestamp:8", one capture per day. Pass "timestamp:14" for one row per distinct capture second.

from.description: Start of date range filter in YYYYMMDD format (history mode only). Example: "20200101".

limit.description: Maximum number of CDX records to return (history mode only, default 100). One call returns at most 10,000: a larger value (up to 150,000) is served as 10,000, and the resume_key continues from there.

mode.description: Lookup mode: "closest" returns the single nearest snapshot to the given timestamp; "history" returns the paginated full capture list via the CDX API.

resume_key.description: Opaque pagination key from a previous history mode response. Pass this to continue from where the last page left off.

status_filter.description: Filter CDX results to a specific HTTP status code (history mode only). Must be a 3-digit numeric code. Example: "200" to return only successful captures.

timestamp.description: Target timestamp in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format (or any prefix thereof). Required for mode=closest. Example: "20200101" for January 1, 2020.

to.description: End of date range filter in YYYYMMDD format (history mode only). Example: "20231231".

url.description: The URL to look up in the Wayback Machine.

name: ia_find_snapshots

cap.description: The limit applied: limit, or 10,000 when a larger value was capped.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_timestamp`: Closest mode was called without a timestamp, or with a blank one. `no_snapshots`: No snapshots found for the given URL with the current filters. `no_snapshot_available`: Closest mode: no capture exists near the requested timestamp for this URL. Either mode: the Wayback Machine does not serve captures of this URL at all — the CDX or Availability API answered HTTP 403, 410, or 451, as it does for a site excluded from the archive. `cdx_unavailable`: The Wayback CDX API answered HTTP 5xx after retries or 429, refused the request with another 4xx, did not answer within the request timeout, could not be reached, or returned an unreadable response; in closest mode, the CDX closest-capture check failed or did not complete in time. `availability_unavailable`: The Wayback Availability API answered HTTP 5xx after retries or 429, refused the request with another 4xx, did not answer within the request timeout, could not be reached, or returned an unreadable response (closest mode). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Set when the list was capped: how to continue, naming resume_key.

resume_key.description: Opaque key to pass as resume_key in the next call to continue paginating CDX history results.

snapshots.description: List of snapshots matching the query.

items.description: A single Wayback Machine snapshot record.

digest.description: SHA-1 digest of the content (history mode).

mimetype.description: MIME type of the captured content (history mode).

replay_url.description: Full Wayback Machine replay URL for this snapshot.

statuscode.description: HTTP status code at time of capture ("-" for a revisit record).

truncated.description: True when the snapshot list was capped at the limit.

title: Find Wayback Machine Snapshots
